script:
set -Eeuo pipefail
mkdir -p /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup
python3 - <<'PY'
import datetime as dt
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess as sp

def run(args):
    result = sp.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True)
    return {"args": args, "code": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}

units = run(["systemctl", "list-unit-files", "--no-legend", "--no-pager", "karpo*"])
timers = run(["systemctl", "list-timers", "--all", "--no-legend", "--no-pager"])
names = {line.split()[0] for line in units["stdout"].splitlines() if line.split()}
names.update(token for token in timers["stdout"].split() if token.startswith("karpo") and token.endswith(".timer"))
actions = []
for name in sorted(names):
    if name.endswith(".timer"):
        actions.append(run(["systemctl", "disable", "--now", name]))
actions.append(run(["shutdown", "-c"]))
proof = {
    "utc": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "policy": "User requests EC2 stays running until good results; no automatic EC2 shutdown in this experiment.",
    "prior_units": units, "prior_timers": timers, "actions": actions,
    "remaining_timers": run(["systemctl", "list-timers", "--all", "--no-pager"]),
    "active_karpo_units": run(["systemctl", "list-units", "--state=running", "--no-pager", "karpo*"]),
    "gpu": run(["nvidia-smi"]),
    "disk": run(["df", "-h", "/opt/karpo"]),
    "environments": [str(p) for p in Path("/opt/karpo").glob("venv*")],
    "shutdown_schedule_exists": Path("/run/systemd/shutdown/scheduled").exists(),
}
assert not proof["shutdown_schedule_exists"]
host = sp.check_output(["hostname"], text=True).strip()
out = Path("/opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup") / f"{host}-preflight.json"
out.write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(proof))
PY
aws s3 cp /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/ s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/results/vllm-rps100-20261120/setup/ --recursive --region us-east-1 --no-progress
